# Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos turns brainstorm into ordered vessels, six lights moving while one waits;
Awtsmoos.com will improve by measured families, then pass the release gates.

## Phase A — Six parallel read-only evidence lanes

1. Fresh 8939 structured semantic runtime verification.
2. Static metadata/H1 coverage inventory for all 79 generated pages.
3. Sitemap/canonical/redirect consistency inventory.
4. Alias/comment/translation dynamic-family audit.
5. Generated artifact collision/external-link/file-existence audit.
6. Git/main/release-state/concurrent-overlap audit.

## Phase B — Implement every safe high-value defect found

- Whole-file writes only.
- New responsibilities split into <=120-line modules.
- Preserve existing authored semantic tags.
- No hidden SEO text, fake titles, fake timestamps, fake ratings, or fake language alternates.

## Phase C — Expand durable tests

- Structured-data runtime and unit contracts.
- Catalog path normalization edge cases.
- Generated metadata file existence/external-link exclusion.
- Comment pagination/sharding fixture boundaries.
- Coverage audit output contracts.
- Translation corpus integrity.

## Phase D — Full compatibility and runtime acceptance

- Focused SEO suite.
- Heichel quality suite.
- Route suite.
- Fresh server acceptance.
- Bounded sitemap crawl.
- Performance thresholds.

## Phase E — Release and public proof

- Fresh origin/main race audit.
- Stage exact Generation-3 paths only.
- Commit/push race-safe.
- Clean worktree guarded activation.
- Raw public origin verification.
- Re-read touched files and compare planned versus actual.
